question: Why did Tesla's gross margin fall in 2023?
summary: Tesla's gross margin fell in FY2023: 25.6% -> 18.2% (-7.3 pts). None of the tested drivers is consistent with the move.

H1: Revenue fell, so fixed manufacturing costs were spread over fewer sales (under-absorption)
H2: Depreciation from heavy capital spending rose as a share of revenue

reference: Automotive gross margin fell mainly on lower average selling prices after price reductions across models (Tesla 2023 10-K, MD&A).
